audit_items.proof_trace: ProcessEpoch uses early returns on error (lines 71,75,79,82,84,89,92,97,102,106,110,114,118), allowing partial execution when any step fails. No rollback mechanism exists, so state modifications from completed steps persist while remaining steps are skipped, violating the all-or-nothing atomicity requirement.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts beacon state that triggers an error in any intermediate epoch processing step (e.g., ProcessRegistryUpdates). First N steps execute and modify state, then execution halts. Remaining 15-N steps never execute, causing state inconsistency across validators.
